asset.name: Aurel app store screenshot 1 ("Five quiet minutes")

dimensions.label: Message clarity
dimensions.evidence: Headline "Five quiet minutes" reads first and matches the brief's promise.
dimensions.fix: Cut the second line; it repeats the headline.

dimensions.label: Brand fit
dimensions.evidence: Rounded cards, pastel ground and open-halo icon follow the art direction.
dimensions.fix: The gradient is stronger than the one-gradient-per-screen rule allows; flatten the top half.

dimensions.label: Distinctiveness
dimensions.evidence: Phone-in-hand on a gradient is the category default.
dimensions.fix: Lead with the reading screen full-bleed instead of a device frame.

dimensions.label: Product truth
dimensions.evidence: Screen is a capture of the current build; no unreleased features shown.

dimensions.label: Hierarchy and composition
dimensions.evidence: Eye goes headline, then screen, then the small caption.
dimensions.fix: Give the headline more space above the device.

dimensions.label: Legibility and accessibility
dimensions.evidence: Caption is lavender on pale blue, about 2.1:1, and vanishes at thumbnail size.
dimensions.fix: Set the caption in the text colour, or remove it.

dimensions.label: Craft
dimensions.evidence: Clean edges, consistent radius, sharp capture.

dimensions.label: Crops and formats
dimensions.evidence: Headline is close to the top edge; the 6.1-inch crop clips the descender.

hard_failures.rule: Unsupported claim or wrong release state
hard_failures.evidence: No product claims beyond the headline.

hard_failures.rule: Invented UI, product, data or logo presented as real
Key text unreadable at the smallest size or below WCAG AA
hard_failures.evidence: Headline passes; only the secondary caption fails, scored under accessibility.

hard_failures.rule: Key information lost in a required crop
hard_failures.evidence: Clipped descender only; headline still reads.

hard_failures.rule: Retired or off-brand colours, type or logo versions
People shown as stereotypes, distorted, or without rights

hard_failures.evidence: First screenshot in the listing; sells the core promise.

top_fixes: Set the caption in the text colour or remove it (accessibility is below its floor).
Replace the device frame with a full-bleed reading screen to stand out from the category.
Move the headline down 80px so it survives the smaller crop.
